value.signature: const fn is_stream_redirected (& self , stream : Stream) -> bool

exception.justification: Justified: Const evaluation cannot emit runtime events; the caller operation accounts its execution without changing this compile-time contract.

review.body: { if self . redirect . is_some () || self . redirect_prefixed . is_some () { return true ; } match stream { Stream :: Stdout => self . redirect_output . is_some () , Stream :: Stderr => self . redirect_error . is_some () , } }
review.item_premise: This body inherits the public-execwrap decision for RoutingConfig::is_stream_redirected.
